err.name: Enter an effect name.
err.level: Level must be a whole number from 0.
err.duration: Duration must be a whole number above zero (or choose “Unlimited”).
err.value: the value must be a number above zero.
err.except: exceptions are pf2e keys in Latin letters, comma-separated.
err.dice: the number of dice must be a whole number above zero.
err.slug: the slug is Latin letters, digits and hyphens (or leave it empty).
err.radius: the radius must be a multiple of 5 from 5 to 240.
err.light: set bright or dim light (numbers of at least zero).
err.rawKey: expected an object with a key field (or an array of those).
err.exceptUnknown: pf2e does not know the type “{key}”.
err.lightDim: dim light cannot be smaller than bright light.

au.denied: This item type has no automation rule.

when.onUse: On use · run by the GM
when.onAttacked: When the owner is attacked: {value} {type} AC

au.areaSpell: Saved to the spell's Area field (system.area): {shape}, {size} ft. The area is not a rule field.

au.dropBad: Drop a condition, effect or macro here.

story.check: The author rolls {stat} against {vs} of each target; the outcome depends on the author's degree.
story.onAttacked: When the owner is attacked, a reaction hint offers {value} {type} AC.

applyMode.button: Conditions are applied by the GM's button in chat (world setting).
applyMode.off: Automatic application is off (world setting): the rule only describes.

au.probeBlocked: Fix the rule errors (see the footer) to see the odds.

au.probeNoTokens: Select or target tokens to see the odds.
au.allFound: All conditions and links were found.
au.notInItem: The rule is not stored in the item

item.title: New item
item.headNew: {type} · will be created in the folder “{folder}”
item.headCopy: Copy of “{name}” · becomes a new item

typeHint.consumable: Potion, elixir, scroll — used up when activated
typeHint.equipment: Passive properties while worn or invested
typeHint.weapon: Damage die and type, group; extra properties as blocks
typeHint.action: An ability with an effect on yourself
typeHint.feat: Passive or action with an effect on yourself

item.copyLabel: Or copy a base from a compendium
item.searchHint: Type at least two letters of the name.
item.baseIs: Base: “{name}” (a copy — a new item, not linked to the original)
item.copyHint: The copy keeps the other pf2e fields — change only what differs. The original and its automation rules are untouched.
item.name: Item name
item.linkNote: A link to the chosen effect is appended to the description automatically — pf2e shows it in chat.
item.dropEffect: Or drag an effect from a compendium or the world onto this frame.
item.passiveNote: A passive ability cannot have an effect on self — pf2e clears it. Pick another type.
item.blocksNote: Properties while the item is worn — the same blocks as in Effect mode; written straight into the item.

does.consumable: The automation rule applies the chosen effect when the consumable is used — to the user or to the selected target.
does.equipment: Rule Elements work while the item is worn (for an item with the Invested trait — while invested too): no extra conditions needed, pf2e requires this itself.
does.weapon: The blocks affect this weapon while it is held (or worn): “all Strikes” is narrowed to the weapon itself.
does.action: The effect is written into pf2e’s native “effect on self” field: the system draws the card button itself.
does.feat: The effect is written into pf2e’s native “effect on self” field: the system draws the card button itself.

item.autoNone: No rule yet: pick an effect on the “What it does” step.
item.autoOff: Auto-build is off — no rule will be written; the effect is applied by hand from the description.

autoNote.rules: This type needs no automation rule: the properties are written into the item and work through pf2e.
autoNote.ability: No automation rule is built for this type: the effect on self is a native pf2e field. Fine-tune in the pipeline after creating.

item.pipeAfter: Available after the item is created.

plan.effect: Effect “{name}” — already exists, will be linked to the item
plan.rule: Automation rule in the item flag
plan.actor: A copy will be given to the actor “{name}”

dest.actor: World and give to the selected ({name})
dest.actorNone: World and give to the selected (no token)

item.footHint: Steps can be done in any order.
item.returnHint: Create the effect — and you return to the item with the effect filled in.
item.descEmpty: The description appears once you write it.

note.effectSelf: Effect: “{name}” is applied to the user.
note.effectTarget: Effect: “{name}” is applied to the selected target.

item.dropBad: Drop an effect or a condition here.
item.stale: The item is already created: further changes will not reach it.
item.closeAsk: The item draft has not been created. Close and discard it?
item.dropNo: An effect can be set on a consumable or a non-passive action/feat.
